title: 玻璃是沙子做的
subtitle: 烧化了，再吹起来
character: wearing an amber yellow t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, warm amber illustration with translucent layered washes and fine dark outlines, amber, honey gold and deep brown over cream, glowing, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
我端着玻璃杯喝水，
阳光照过来，
杯子是透明的。
爸爸说，
这是沙子做的。我不信。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a clear glass of water up toward the light, looking through it, curious.

pages.zh:
真的是沙子。
不过不是随便什么沙，
是一种很白很细的沙，
里面几乎全是
一种叫二氧化硅的东西。
pages.scene: One small heap of fine pale sand on a cream background, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把沙子烧到很热很热，
一千七百度那么热，
它就会「熔化」，
变成像蜂蜜一样
黏黏的、会流动的液体。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two bowls side by side on a cream background: the left holding loose grains, the right holding a smooth thick flowing liquid. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
熔化以后趁热做形状。
可以倒进模子里，
也可以用一根长管子
蘸一团，
然后往里吹气。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long tube on a cream background with a round blob at its far end, and one arrow entering the near end of the tube. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一边吹一边转，
那团玻璃就慢慢鼓起来，
变成一个空心的泡。
杯子、瓶子，
都是这样鼓出来的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three blobs in a row on a cream background, each one larger and more hollow than the last, the third clearly a cup shape. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
为什么玻璃是透明的呢？
因为它里面的东西
排得乱七八糟，
却又挨得很紧，
光可以直接穿过去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one square on a cream background filled with small specks arranged with no pattern, and three straight rays passing right through it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
玻璃冷下来就变硬。
可是它硬得很脆，
一摔就碎，
碎片还很锋利。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one plain drinking glass on the left of a cream background and several sharp-edged fragments on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以玻璃碎了，
千万不要用手去捡。
要告诉大人，
用扫把和簸箕，
再用湿纸巾把小渣子粘走。
pages.scene: One broom and one dustpan on a cream background beside a few scattered fragments, with a hand drawn reaching for the broom handle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
玻璃可以一直回收。
把旧玻璃打碎，
重新烧化，
再做成新的瓶子，
质量一点也不差。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circular loop of arrows on a cream background with three small symbols spaced around it: a bottle, broken pieces, and a melting pot. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
而且回收玻璃更省事。
碎玻璃比沙子
更容易熔化，
烧的时候能省下
不少电和气。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two thermometers side by side on a cream background: the left one with the liquid high, the right one clearly lower. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
玻璃还有很多用处。
窗户、眼镜、显微镜，
还有很细很细的玻璃丝，
能把光和信号
送到很远的地方。
pages.scene: Three small pictures in a row on a cream background: a window pane, a pair of spectacles, and a thin glowing thread. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又举起杯子看了看。
原来手里这只杯子，
以前是海边的沙。
烧化，吹起来，
就变成了它。
pages.scene: The little boy holds the glass up to the light again, looking through it with a new understanding, smiling.
